findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - a repository configures always_test and a task names a nonexistent test in an existing file. The collection hook retains the always_test cases, while session completion validates only REQUIRED, which contains always_test entries (src/forge/fasttest.py:455–460). If those cases pass, forge test returns success even though none of the task's named tests matched, and prints no no-tests warning. This misses the Done-when requirement that an unmatched selection must not pass as if its tests ran. Validate that the task selection itself matched independently of always_test; the new empty-selection test currently exercises only the case without always_test.
